people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
translations.bsb: God sent a spirit of animosity between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem and caused them to treat Abimelech deceitfully,
